title: China’s Weaponization of Dual-Use Research Vessels for Undersea Data Dominance
summary_en: Analysis of 223 vessels finds that Chinese research ships spend an unusually large share of time near subsea infrastructure on the high seas. The findings call for stronger allied monitoring, coordinated patrols, and faster cable repair.
title_cn: China’s Weaponization of Dual-Use Research Vessels for Undersea Data Dominance

title: Space Intelligence: The Foundation of Space Superiority
summary_en: Space superiority depends on knowing what adversaries can do and recognizing when their behavior changes. Persistent collection and analysis across government, industry, and allies can help anticipate threats before they materialize.
title_cn: Space Intelligence: The Foundation of Space Superiority
